venue.name: Kwisitis Visitor Centre
venue.description: The Kwisitis Visitor Centre is Parks Canada's two-storey visitor centre in the Long Beach Unit of Pacific Rim National Park Reserve, at the south end of Wickaninnish Beach near Ucluelet. The building was completed in 1965 as the Wickaninnish Inn and was rebuilt by Parks Canada between 1978 and 1982 into a visitor centre with display space, a theatre and a restaurant section; it was recognized as a Federal Heritage Building in 2019. The centre sits above the beach with its own parking lot, service road, small trails and a boardwalk system down to the sand.
venue.seasonal_notes: The Kʷisitis area at the south end of Wickaninnish Beach will be closed to the public from Wednesday, September 16 to Friday, September 25, 2026, inclusive, in recognition of Yuułuʔiłʔatḥ's historical and modern connection to their ḥaw̓iiḥ ḥaḥuułi (hereditary chiefs' territory). This closure includes the Kʷisitis Visitor Centre, the Kʷisitis Visitor Centre parking lot, the South Beach trail, the Nuu-chah-nulth trail, and the southern end of Wickaninnish Beach (including Lismer Beach and South Beach).
